scientific_integrity: Universal proof, explicit equality rigidity, canonical spanning-tree bijection and exchange-graph identification; two independent finite checkers and recorded outputs. No unsupported existence or external-audit claim.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to existing finite projective planes of order q>=2. General theorem proved from plane axioms; tests only for q=2,3. Full-text priority comparison with general connected-domination paper incomplete and independent external priority verification unperformed.
title: Flag rigidity and sharp exchange threshold for connected domination in projective-plane incidence graphs
